claims.evidence: Today, we release the weights of a new and improved Le Chonk, advancing the open frontier for agentic coding and cybersecurity.

claims.text: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open-weight promptable model for multilingual speech transcription, on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
claims.evidence: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an open-weight, promptable model that turns recorded speech into useful text, now available on Hugging Face and ModelScope .

claims.text: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe combines its speech encoder with a hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts model having approximately 4 billion active parameters out of 30 billion total.

claims.evidence: Liquid AI announced LFM3 on October 27, 2026, a new generation of open-weight Liquid Foundation Models that brings text, vision, audio, omni, and decision models onto one shared backbone.
claims.text: Liquid AI announced LFM3, a new generation of open-weight Liquid Foundation Models sharing a common backbone across multiple modalities.
The initial LFM3 release comprises six open-weight models in the 2-billion-parameter range covering text, vision, audio, omni, and decision tasks.
claims.evidence: The first release, detailed in a post on the Hugging Face blog, covers six models in the 2B parameter range.

claims.text: Beam is scheduled for release under an Apache 2.0 license featuring quantized FP8 and NVFP4 numerics.

claims.text: The model weights are hosted on Hugging Face with MXFP4 quantization enabled by default.
claims.evidence: The weights live on Hugging Face with MXFP4 quantization as the default.
